rationale: The agent did not follow policy or fully address the user’s requests. Issues: (1) No clear user authentication beyond looking up by email. (2) Performed an order-changing write (modified payment method) without first confirming with the user. (3) Did not answer the gift card balance question. (4) Did not state which card was used for the recent order before changing it, nor whether a gift card could be applied. (5) Stated a refund would be issued from the prior card without evidence and despite the order being marked pending, which could be inaccurate. Therefore, the task was not completed per policy.
